card.name: End of warning section headings
card.fires_on: The last word of a warning heading, such as 'Misuse' in 'Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse', just before the body text begins. Also the end of headings like 'Myelosuppression' or 'Severe Allergic Reactions'.

modes.label: Misuse in opioid heading
modes.description: The final word 'Misuse' of the boxed-warning heading 'Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse' in opioid labels.

modes.label: Other numbered section headings
modes.description: The closing word of a numbered Warnings and Precautions heading, right before its paragraph starts.
